trending.title: The Odyssey
trending.overview: Odysseus, the legendary King of Ithaca, embarks on a long and perilous journey home following the Trojan War. trending.title: Model Citizen

Instead, he's met with rising hostility, strange surveillance, and instincts he can’t fully control. When the pressure becomes unbearable, Bay begins a desperate hunt for the truth behind his fractured reality.

trending.overview: War reduced Japan to zero, and Godzilla plunged it into minus. trending.title: Spider-Man: Brand New Day
